weekNotice: Fire weather only, less certain, not scored yet.
_review: English source text. Forecast values are estimates [U].
title: Risk outlook (unofficial)
proof: How we know it is right
failed: Risk data could not be loaded. Try again later; follow official services.
missingInputs: Some inputs are missing. This does not mean no risk.
empty: No forecast here for this region and date.
missingCountry: No forecast file is available for this country.
zeroEstimate: The model estimates a zero chance
probability: Estimated chance: {p}. This is not a guarantee.
crew: Consider a standby team near here tomorrow. Decisions rest with the fire service.
crewToday: Consider a standby team near here today. Decisions rest with the fire service.
officialServices: Follow your national and local fire service.
disclaimer: Research prototype. Not an official warning. Follow local authorities (112).
placeholder: Tomorrow's fire risk: being built and tested. Here is what it will show.
plannedSpots: Ranked spots for today and tomorrow, with their chance of fire.
plannedWhy: Reasons for each spot, fuel type and its fire history.
plannedProof: Checks against satellite detections and official fire weather.
coverage: Only ranked spots are included. A place without a forecast is not a place without risk.
estimates: Ranks, levels, chances and point locations are research estimates.
mapHint: Tap a region label or the map to choose a region. Points are sized by level.
mapFailed: Map unavailable. Use the region picker above.
tilesUnavailable: Base imagery unavailable. Ranked points and the region picker still work.
mapApproximate: Region selection uses approximate boxes, not administrative boundaries.
emptyForest: No forest or wildland spots are available in this region for this date.
stale: Forecast made for {date}; not updated since
levelMeaning: The level is the chance that satellites detect a new vegetation fire in this roughly 28 km square on that day, including field burning. It is not a danger rating.
